decisions.reason: Conferencing is a low-investment add-on outside the announced software-defined infrastructure direction, and the firm has made little visible commitment to it, but keeping it within the broad portfolio costs little and pandemic-era demand gives a temporary reason to persist.
The metro data centre network rests on owned fibre investment, has publicly reported adoption, and is central to the announced data centre and cloud direction, so commitment remains strong.
Optical spectrum connectivity draws on sunk fibre investment, was showcased on its own page, and fits the high-bandwidth strategy, so the firm persists with it.
Direct voice network connection builds on the established voice infrastructure and serves enterprise customers, so the firm keeps it even though legacy voice is declining in importance.
